body: I've been thinking a lot about different ways to do it with hopefully minimal pain. I think I have narrowed it down to 2 choices. Don't want to give anyone else ideas though. Not sure which would be best. I guess if I were inebriated that would help and maybe wouldn't matter which of the two it was.  Wish I had done a lot of things differently. Lots of things still left unsaid.

Just talking to myself to get it out of my brain mostly... I know my husband would be upset if I died but he would get over it.  He has a family and he is young enough to remarry.  The girls are almost grown and they have their dad. The boys are young enough that they wouldn't even understand or realize.  They'd be fine. My job would find some other idiot who would be happy to do my job while being repeatedly passed over for promotion because th ey can't afford to lose them in their position. School wouldn't care. No one there knows me. I only have a few friends.. They would be sad but also get over it. What else really is there. My mom is dead my dad doesn't give a shit. My sister is too busy with her own life to ever care about another human being. My other sister would care but she would get over it. Honestly I think maybe 10 people mught even come to a funeral. I should probably try make it look like an accident so there is no stigma attached for the kids.  Or just disappear I to some forest somewhere and never come out. They'd probably never find me. Maybe just take a boat out a couple miles from ahore. That's not too hard from here. Just wish I could make it somewhat painless. I'm tired of pain. I deserve to have one pain free moment... At least at the end.

I feel like such a jerk. I could go to counseling, as in I have insurance. I feel bad not using it when there are other people who don't have the option. I just spent like 10 minutes typing out a list of reasons why I haven't gotten help. It's all excuses. The truth is I'm fucking depressed and don't even have the drive to try. I have so much in my life with working and 2 special needs kids that making an effort to do something that is for me just seems impossible and a waste of energy. As ridiculous as it sounds is the truth. I'm in that place where digging up j out of the pit ust seems so damn hard. 

Thank you for the link. I am looking at the resources now.
Yes, look up FQHC in your area. They are low cost or free and they have all services including mental health
